definitions.explanation: Things of value that a person or organization owns, including money, land, and possessions.
A large amount of money or valuable possessions.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{財産|ざいさん}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{失|うしな}った。
{財産|ざいさん}を{子供|こども}たちに{残|のこ}したい。
examples.english: I want to leave my fortune to my children.

examples.japanese: {知識|ちしき}は{一生|いっしょう}の{財産|ざいさん}です。

notes:
{財産|ざいさん} refers to property, assets, or wealth.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {財産|ざいさん}を{築|きず}く (build up one's fortune)
- {財産|ざいさん}を{相続|そうぞく}する (inherit property)
- {財産|ざいさん}を{管理|かんり}する (manage assets)
- {知的|ちてき}{財産|ざいさん} (intellectual property)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {資産|しさん}: assets (more formal, business term)
- {財産|ざいさん}: property, wealth (general)
- お{金|かね}: money
- {富|とみ}: wealth, fortune
